description: End a live room session: disconnects all participants and wipes the room contents (chat history, AI messages). Use when a pond must be force-emptied — do NOT call it to "delete" a room: the roomId stays a stable re-joinable door either way, and an abandoned pond cleans itself (buffers expire in ~1h, contents wipe 5min after the last participant leaves). Only works on live rooms that are not host-moderated.
name: close_pond
title: Close pond
